# MapLibre browser assets

- `maplibre-gl.js` and `maplibre-gl.css` come from `maplibre-gl@5.24.1` on npm. The browser bundle includes its worker.
- `leaflet-maplibre-gl.js` comes from `@maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@0.1.4` on npm and supports the existing vendored Leaflet 1.9.4.

Use the published `dist` files and retain the accompanying licenses when updating either package.
